categories_thin: Pool service and repair - about a dozen Edison-based entries after re-searching; most pool searches return firms based in Metuchen, East Brunswick, Woodbridge or Piscataway that only serve Edison, and national retailers had to be excluded.
Pool and masonry supply yards - Edison has almost no standalone masonry/brick supply yard; the nearest yards found are in Piscataway and Sayreville, i.e. outside the zone.
Appliances - few Edison-address repair firms. Several Google results are multi-city lead-generation brands with no address, and Mr. Appliance is a franchise and was excluded.
Locksmiths - very thin. Only one walk-in Edison locksmith (Brothers Lock & Safe) could be confirmed; most other results were call-centre style listings or national key-duplication brands.
Self storage - dominated by national brands (Public Storage, Extra Space, U-Haul, Storage Sense, Storage Star) which are excluded; only two clearly local facilities remain.

Chimney, gutters, fencing, garage doors - many service-area brands marketing under suite or residential addresses rather than real yards; after address checks, gutters and fencing are down to a handful of Edison entries.

Drywall and tree service - several entries in the original list turned out to be addressed in other towns (New Brunswick, Plainfield, Montclair, Harrison, East Brunswick, South Plainfield) and were removed, so both categories are thinner than they look.
caveats: This revision removed every entry the verifier flagged as wrong-town or excluded-type: Bill Leary, Penyak Roofing, Gold Medal Service, Keys That Please, Noll Brothers, Christensen Recycling, Viking Pest Control, General Floor and GuardMe Security, plus the four own-site entries with no Edison address (Michael Mandell Plumbing, Air Cubes HVAC, Flowfix Plumbing, Pro Plumbers of Edison).

Roughly 45 further entries were removed after their street address resolved to a different municipality in OpenStreetMap: Plainfield, South Plainfield, New Brunswick, Highland Park, Woodbridge/Iselin, Sayreville, Perth Amboy, North Brunswick, East Brunswick, Union, Scotch Plains, Rahway, Newark, Camden, Paterson, Clifton, Kearny, Fort Lee, Harrison, Montclair, Mount Olive, Old Bridge, Hamilton, Bayonne, Lambertville, Lopatcong, Trenton, Princeton and Eastampton.

Eleven listed Edison addresses were confirmed inside Edison by OpenStreetMap address lookup (Sturgis Rd, Michael St, Burchard St, Char St, George Ave, Bradley Dr, Eastlick Rd, Hill Rd, Cinder Rd, Amboy Ave, Taylor Rd); those entries say so in active_evidence. Most other entries rest on the address shown in the Google Maps listing and were not independently verified.

Entries that were branded multi-city chains or lead-generation service-area sites were removed even where the verifier did not flag them: Storage Sense, Storage Star, FDP Mold Remediation, Green Guard Mold Remediation, Exclusive Heating AC Sewer & Drain, Taj Mahal Electrical, A&J Professional Services and American Roofing & Contracting.
Rating and review counts from the original research were shown in Google Maps at the time and were not re-verified in this revision; active_evidence now says so explicitly.

A number of remaining entries are service-area operators with residential, apartment or suite addresses. Their town is Edison per the listing but the premises may be a home office; this is flagged in notes.

National and regional chains, franchises and branded service networks were excluded per brief (Pep Boys, Mavis, Terminix, SERVPRO, PuroClean, Two Men and a Truck, Stanley Steemer, Public Storage, Extra Space, U-Haul, KeyMe, Floor & Decor, The Tile Shop, Power Home Remodeling, Window World, CertaPro, Two Maids, Molly Maid, MaidPro, Ace Handyman, 1-800-GOT-JUNK, Mr. Appliance, Leslie's, American Pool, Precision Door).

Four chamber-listed contractors (Milano Contracting, Lenguy Construction, Gulberg Builders, NJ Paver) and several directory-only businesses were added during revision; each rests on a single directory source and needs confirmation.
data_gaps: Yellow Pages, Superpages, BBB, Angi, Manta, ChamberofCommerce.com, Hotfrog, Nicelocal and Cylex returned HTTP 403/Cloudflare blocks when fetched directly; where used they are cited only as URLs returned by search, without page-level verification.
OpenStreetMap Overpass API was unreachable; only the Nominatim address-lookup endpoint worked, and it can only tell where an address sits, not whether the business still occupies it.
Edison Township's own business directory or licensed-business list could not be located; the Edison Chamber of Commerce directory was used instead and it contains many non-Edison members.
Websites are blank where none was seen linked in a listing or opened during research; the triage team should look them up.
Phone or street address is missing for a number of service-area listings (marked Unknown).

Two entries share the 51 Saw Mill Pond Rd pool-supply address (Champion Pool Distributors, The Pool Factory) and two share 2 Sutton Place (Todd Harris Company, Spa & Pool Store); the relationships between them are unconfirmed.
